When an agent requests a tool call, the execution boundary should not depend on the model remembering not to perform destructive actions.

The runtime rejects execution above the declared policy tier before invoking tools. This deterministic gate ensures that authorization happens outside the probabilistic layer.

## The Execution Sandbox

In a policy-governed runtime, capabilities are declared statically. The agent emits a structured intent, but the host environment verifies permissions against immutable credentials.

## Failure Recovery

If a policy check fails, the runtime returns an explicit permission fault rather than terminating the session.
